stem:
Myra hangs a clay bob from a string to make a simple pendulum. She pulls the bob aside and lets it swing freely. O is the mean position; P and Q are the extreme positions.

Which motion of the bob is one complete oscillation?

options.text: From O to P, then through O to Q, then back to O.
O to P, then back to O.
An oscillation cannot be completed if counting starts at P.

teacher.key_rationale: One oscillation is mean to one extreme, through mean to the other extreme, and back to mean. Half trips and forbidding a start at an extreme miss that path.
